restaurant_name: The Diamond Rehab Thailand - Luxury rehab in Hua Hin
text:
I will forever be grateful to The Diamond, and to everyone who makes this place the life-changing sanctuary that it is — the counselors, psychologists, nurses, massage therapist, support staff, housekeepers, kitchen team, and security. From the moment I arrived, every single person treated me with kindness, understanding, and compassion.

When I came here eight weeks ago, I was completely broken, lost, and hopeless. I didn’t believe I had anywhere to turn. But through the combination of powerful group sessions and deeply personal one-on-one work, I slowly began to rebuild myself. The journey was not always easy — it was filled with tears, anger, and uncomfortable self-work — but also moments of joy, laughter, connection, and deep gratitude. Extending my stay from one month to two was one of the best decisions I have ever made. Today, I am leaving with not just sobriety, but with hope and the knowledge, tools, and sense of self I never thought I’d find again.

The Diamond is more than just a rehab center — it is a community. I will never forget anyone I have encountered here. From the moment I arrived, I was surrounded by people who understood me in a way the outside world often couldn’t. Fellow clients quickly became confidants, cheerleaders, and mirrors, reflecting both my struggles and my progress back to me with honesty and compassion. The staff foster an environment where bonds can form naturally, and where vulnerability is met with understanding rather than judgment. This sense of connection has been just as healing as the therapy itself, reminding me that recovery doesn’t happen in isolation, but in the presence of people who truly care.

I want to say a heartfelt thank you to Caroline, my psychologist, for always being so kind, patient, and caring. She created a safe space where I felt truly heard, and she gently guided me as I unpacked and worked through my past. Her calm, reassuring presence helped ease my anxieties and gave me the confidence to keep moving forward. I’m deeply grateful for the compassion and understanding she’s shown me throughout our sessions.

Last but not least, I want to thank the clinical director and my counselor, Travis, who I truly believe gave me a second chance at life. He is, without question, the best counselor I could have hoped for — deeply dedicated to his work, to helping others, and to every single one of his clients. Travis has an extraordinary ability to truly see and hear his clients, to understand not just the words they say but the pain, hurt, and deep-seated emotions beneath them. He pushed me to do the uncomfortable work that was necessary for my growth, balancing firmness with compassion in exactly the way I needed. He put his heart and soul into working with me, often taking extra time between sessions to check in if I was struggling, making sure I had the strength to get through the day. That kind of care is rare, and I will never forget it. I don’t think I would have extended my stay if it weren’t for his guidance and support. He treats each client as a person, not a number, and his dedication is felt in every interaction. Through our work, he helped me begin transforming my self-hatred into acceptance, my hurt into laughter, and my hopelessness into a belief in the future. I am walking away from The Diamond with more self-awareness, resilience, and hope than I ever thought possible — and for that, I will always be grateful to him.

The Diamond has given me far more than sobriety — it has given me a new beginning. I leave here feeling stronger, wiser, and ready to face life with clarity and courage. My gratitude for this place and these people is endless.

Thank you all ❤️

restaurant_name: The Diamond Rehab Thailand - Luxury rehab in Hua Hin
text:
My 7-week stay at The Diamond Luxury Rehab in Hua Hin for a gambling addiction, a condition I've learned is a serious mental disorder, has been nothing short of transformative. While the resort and pool are clearly 5-star and provide a comfortable and serene environment, it is unequivocally the staff and counsellors who elevate this facility to a true luxury rehab.
During my time here, I received a comprehensive and personalised treatment plan, which included four therapy sessions per week – two with an addiction specialist and two with a psychotherapist.
Travis, my addiction specialist, has been instrumental in what I can only describe as saving not only my life but also the future of my family. His insightful approach helped me uncover critical blind spots in my behaviour that were fuelling my addiction. Without his guidance, I wouldn't have gained the understanding I now have of my actions and their consequences.
Caroline, my psychotherapist, was equally brilliant. Her kind, caring, and compassionate nature created a calming and trusting space where I felt comfortable enough to delve deep into my actions and the underlying reasons for them. Her support was a crucial element of my healing process.
Beyond Travis and Caroline, every single member of the team at The Diamond is extraordinary. From the dedicated cleaners who maintain the immaculate environment to the incredibly supportive staff (extra credit to Chai, Judi, Pink and Noey) everyone greets you with a genuine smile. Their collective positivity significantly contributes to the creation of a calming atmosphere.
Adding to the recovery experience, weekend excursions provided unforgettable opportunities to explore the beauty of Thailand, offering a welcome balance to the intensive therapeutic work.
I cannot recommend The Diamond Luxury Rehab highly enough. They have genuinely changed my life for the better, equipping me with the tools and understanding to move forward. I will forever be grateful to the entire team for their dedication, professionalism, and unwavering support. This place is a beacon of hope.

This isn’t just a facility—it’s a sanctuary designed to make you feel safe, cared for, and valued as a person.

17 Oct 2024

I was feeling REALLY low – worst ever and thought I had better do something about it

I have been to Thailand at Rehab before and started to google places. Luckily I found the Diamond!! My wife and I read all about it and decided this is the place I need to go. I have been suffering from Mental Health issues, mainly depression for over 25 years now. I have tried everything, hypnotism, sound treatment, courses, treatments, pills, meditation etc etc – everything I could get my hands on over the years. Over the last year we have been through some VERY trying times financially and this has led me to drink excessively and not cope as things dragged out. I got worse and worse until finally the tank was empty, physically and mentally drained beyond belief, I could barely string a sentence together, zero energy. We have built up a nice lifestyle, properties etc over the years and this was looking like me may lose a large chunk of it, not ideal at the age of 60 when you’re supposed to be enjoying your retirement you worked for!

I made the decision to book for a month – talked to Craig, who is awesome, and made a plan. I got so run down I actually moved the date forward a month and off I went.

Well what an experience! This place is right up there with the best in the world, and affordable! The staff are all awesome, smiling all the time, greet you and acknowledge you when they see you, even the chefs and kitchen staff. The food is prepared fresh every day and is exceptional. Accommodation you have your own Villa which again is 5 star, deck out front facing the pool to relax in the warmth. Everything you need is there and if its not they will get it for you.

Grounds are kelp to a very high standard and pool serviced regularly.

There is a nurse onsite 24 hours for medication dispersal, pain help, blood pressure in monitored every morning. There is a doctor on call if you need more help. They are extremely friendly and helpful and help you to feel at ease.

Craig, & Travis are legends with over 20 years and more experience, they really know their stuff. There are 3 sessions each day and all very interesting and helpful. Then there are one on one sessions to personally suit you.

The other counsellors are also top class and there to help and listen – absolutely nothing is a problem.

During my time I unfortunately went into serious pain. Nurse examined me immediately and off to the hospital immediately. Within an hour I was under sedative, admitted, had a CT scan, X ray, MRI and surgery that night!! Unbelievable service. I got my gall bladder removed and was back at the Diamond in 2 days. During my stay Craig, his wife and a counsellor Lorraine visited every day and evening between them. Over and above the call of duty, they take personal caré and attention to us all.

The programme at Diamond definitely works and is a result of Craig and Travis’s personal experiences over the years, not from a book or u tube etc.

On interview I told Craig I need an oil change, I left with a complete overhaul haha!

I can honestly say this has been the best 5 weeks of my life ( I extended a week). Feel fantastic more and more each day all day, something I have missed for years! It is the best thing I have done for myself ever, no question.

Don’t look any further this is the place! Don’t procrastinate – JUST DO IT. I am happy for Craig to release my contact details should anyone have any further questions

Mark Wikstrom - New Zealand
